messages:
alex: CI turned red on master, failing TestSessionExpiryRace on ci-7. Not sure if it's deterministic.
maya: saw it as well, just one failure in the matrix (linux-gcc-11). logs attached in the job.
cheng: error looks like an assertion in session_state.go:42 — "expected ttl <= 30s, got 38s". stack: runtime scheduler + expire loop.
alex: failing only on the stress shard (parallel=16). non-deterministic timing smell. can someone kick a rerun with the same seed if we have it?
ops-bot: Re-run requested by alex. Job: https://ci.internal.redwood/job/12345.
sam: grabbing the job log — there's also a WARN about clock skew right before the assertion: "clock drift detected: 12ms".
jen: does the test set any system time mocks? I think it uses real clock and sleeps.
cheng: it uses a small sleep + simulated scheduler pulses. I suspect jitter in the timer wheel combined with parallel GC.
maya: can we repro locally? I can try `./dev/ci_run.sh --filter TestSessionExpiryRace --repeat 200 --workers 8` tonight.
alex: please include `--seed` if available. the CI artifacts show seed 83429 in the flaky-run meta.
sam: kicked a local run with seed 83429, got one failure after ~45 runs on my mac. stack trace same.
jen: ok that's helpful — it's at least reproducible. can you attach the full trace and the minimal repro steps to the PR?
cheng: quick triage thoughts: we either (1) tighten the test timing tolerances (increase allowed ttl range), (2) make the test use a fake clock, or (3) add a short retry/backoff in the assertion to account for transient jitter. prefer fake clock if feasible.
maya: fake clock would be ideal but might be a bigger change. for short-term unblocking i'd vote for bumping tolerance to <= 45s and adding an explanatory comment + ticket to follow up.
alex: agree short-term tolerance bump + a linked ticket. can someone file a bug with reproduction steps, seed 83429, job link and stack?
sam: filing now — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9421 (includes seed, steps, stack). tagging cheng to own fix.
cheng: I'll take the INF-9421. plan: 1) quick test tolerance bump in a PR (small), 2) follow-up to switch to fake clock in the session expiry tests.
jen: ping me on the PR for review. also let's add the flaky label so CI flakes board picks it up.
ops-bot: Label added: flaky-test.
maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5201 — increases assertion window and adds comment + jira link.
alex: thanks — merging the quick fix once green. whoever runs the next CI matrix please watch that linux-gcc-11 stress shard.
sam: will watch. if it keeps failing we'll bisect the commit range between 1745... -> 1751... to find regression.
cheng: note: measured that GC pause patterns on linux-gcc-11 variant differ slightly; will instrument timers in follow-up.
jen: and add a small note in the release notes about the flaky test so customer-facing alerts aren't noisy.
alex: awesome, thanks team :thumbsup:
maya: follow-up action items summarized in INF-9421.
jen: resolving thread once PR merges.
